title: Navboard: company slate & cadence (planning spike)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working ‘navboard’ for the upcoming company planning window: synthesize a compact set of company-level commitments, draft OKRs for the next 90 days, and a lean run-of-show for the all-staff town (T+2 weeks). Treat as a collaboration pad — informal notes, tradeoffs, and open asks are expected.

Context & constraints:
- Market: sustained hiring/scale in infra + greater enterprise interest for private deployments. We need to tighten narratives around reliability, predictable economics, and regulatory posture.
- Budget: modest hiring headroom in Q2; prioritize cross-team levered investments (runtime autoscaler, console rollouts, and Optimize pilot).
- Customer signals: 3 pilot enterprise trials requesting dedicated capacity SLAs; several hosted customers asking for lower tail latency guarantees.

Outputs we need by the planning deadline (2026-02-18):
1) A 3–4 OKR slate (company-level) with measurable leading indicators and owners.
2) Short exec update lines (for founders + GTM leads) for the town presentation.
3) All-staff run-of-show + small facilitator script (15–20 minutes leadership slate, 30–40 min breakout + live Q&A).
4) Decision log of any scope tradeoffs (which initiatives get runway vs deferred).

Proposal: company OKR draft (90 days) — compact and testable
Objective A: Make inference predictable and affordable for product teams
- KR A1: Reduce median and 95th percentile token latency on hosted API by 15% (median) and 20% (95th) for standard gen workloads (baseline: Jan 2026).
- KR A2: Deliver Optimize pilot to 10 internal + 5 external customers, demonstrating at least 12% cost reduction per inference workload in production.
- KR A3: Publish a performance catalog (top 10 model+hardware combos) with documented SLOs and cost-per-token guidance.
Owners: Eng-serving-runtime (lead), Product-optimize (co-lead)

Objective B: Make Dedicated and Private ready for enterprise scale
- KR B1: Complete private control plane hardening (KMS/HSM integrations + audit pipeline) and pass an internal compliance checklist (12 items).
- KR B2: Ship Dedicated autoscaling policy v1 and validate against 2 high-throughput customer simulations (throughput target: 4x seen baseline).
- KR B3: Sign 1 paid Dedicated contract (pilot) with SLA terms agreed.
Owners: Eng-private-deployments, Sales-enterprise, Security

Objective C: Improve visibility & developer experience for production customers
- KR C1: Roll out token-level cost telemetry to customers (beta) for 5 pilot teams.
- KR C2: Reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) customer-facing degradation events by 30% through observability and alert playbooks.
- KR C3: Ship first iteration of a self-service rollout (canary → auto-fallback) available to hosted tenants.
Owners: Console-and-tooling, Observability, Developer-experience

Tradeoff notes (quick):
- Hard choice: Prioritize autoscaling reliability (B) vs aggressive latency optimizations (A). Suggest split funding: majority to latency kernel improvements but keep a small cross-team sprint for autoscaler MVP to unblock Dedicated pilots.
- Hiring asks: one infra SRE (critical), one senior backend (runtime), one product manager for Dedicated launch. Recommend delaying non-critical IC hires.

Exec update bullets (2–3 lines each) for town slides
- Founders: Open with posture — “Our northstar: predictable inference economics. This quarter we ship the Optimize pilot and productize Dedicated autoscaler.”
- Product: “Delivering clearer performance guarantees via a published catalog and self-service rollouts.”
- Engineering: “Focus on kernel-level latency wins + KV cache efficiency; autoscaler MVP for Dedicated.”
- GTM: “Narrow enterprise funnel to 3 pilots; clear SLA negotiation path and pricing anchors.”

All-staff run-of-show (proposed, 75 minutes total)
- 0–5’: Welcome & framing (Founders) — agenda + success criteria
- 5–20’: Leadership slate (Founders + SVPs) — OKRs and executive bullets (15’)
- 20–35’: Customer vignette (recorded 5’ + live 10’ discussion) — pilot enterprise using Dedicated
- 35–55’: Breakouts by focus lane (15’ breakouts + 5’ report back): 
   * Lane 1: Reliability & runtime optimizations (eng leads)
   * Lane 2: Dedicated + Private launch plan (product + sales)
   * Lane 3: Developer experience & console features (dx + console)
- 55–75’: Live Q&A (moderated) + closing (founders)

Facilitator notes (for the breakouts):
- Provide a 1-pager prompt to each group with 3 questions: 1) What’s the biggest risk to hitting our KRs? 2) What cross-team dependency must be resolved within 14 days? 3) What is one concrete experiment we can run in the next sprint?
- Each group nominates a reporter to paste a 3–4 line summary in the shared jamboard link during their breakout.

Open decisions & outstanding asks (explicit)
- Decision 1: Final OKR slate — need exec sign-off by 2026-02-12. (Owner: Maya Lin)
- Decision 2: Budget reallocation for kernel work vs autoscaler — finance needs recommendation by 2026-02-09. (Owner: Carlos Rivera)
- Ask: Sales to surface top 5 enterprise objections to SLA/pricing by 2026-02-08 (Owner: Priya Shah)

Risks & mitigations (short)
- Risk: Kernel-level latency work uncovers model-architecture incompatibilities. Mitigation: maintain fallback model variants and measure regression with eval set.
- Risk: Dedicated trials overload support. Mitigation: require success criteria and staging verification before on-boarding; designate a support-on-call pattern.

Notes-to-self / writer’s asides (informal)
- Keep town slides visual — one slide per OKR with baseline numbers.
- Do not over-commit new API features in this slate; focus on operations and material customer-facing levers.
- Ping #leadership-sync for sign-off thread; post an exec summary in Confluence NB-1823 and mention linked JIRA OPS-2741 for budget work.

Next steps & timeline
- 2026-02-05: Draft shared to exec for comments (this doc).
- 2026-02-09: Finance recommendation due.
- 2026-02-12: Exec sign-off on OKRs.
- 2026-02-18: Final town deck + run-of-show locked.

Attachments & references (working links):
- Confluence NB-1823 (compendium of metrics and baseline dashboards)
- JIRA OPS-2741 (budget reallocation task)
- GitHub PR: company-comms/pull/58 — initial town deck draft

End — PLEASE COMMENT DIRECTLY IN THIS DOC (highlight open bullets you can own).
